claims: Jack Nicklaus holds the record for the most Masters Tournament victories.
Jack Nicklaus won six Green Jackets at the Masters Tournament in 1963, 1965, 1966, 1972, 1975, and 1986.
Jack Nicklaus's Masters Tournament victories spanned 23 years.
Jack Nicklaus's Masters Tournament victories spanned three decades.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters Tournament consecutively in 1965 and 1966.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters Tournament wire-to-wire in 1972.
Jack Nicklaus was 46 years and 82 days old during his 1986 Masters Tournament victory.
Jack Nicklaus's 1986 Masters Tournament victory made him the oldest champion in tournament history.
In the 1986 Masters Tournament, Jack Nicklaus started the final round four strokes behind the leader.
Jack Nicklaus finished as runner-up at the Masters Tournament four times.
Jack Nicklaus secured 15 top-10 finishes at the Masters Tournament in his career
